# api.mjs

[Source](https://github.com/uol-library/spacefinder/blob/develop/assets/js/modules/api.mjs)

The API for pages that embed the app

A page can control the app with these methods, which are on
window.spacefinderAPI (or can be imported from this module), and follow
what the user does with the app's events (see the Embedding guide in the
documentation). In an iframe, embed.mjs makes the same methods and events
available with postMessage.

Most methods need the current dataset to have loaded: wait for
spacefinderAPI.ready (a Promise), or the sfready event, before using
them. While a dataset is loading (for example after switchDataSource),
they return false.

Everything the methods return can be copied with structuredClone, so it
can be sent with postMessage.

**Exports:** `api`

<a name="api.ready"></a>

### api.ready : <code>Promise</code>
Resolves (with the API) when the first dataset has loaded

**Kind**: static property of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
<a name="api.getDataSources"></a>

### api.getDataSources() ⇒ <code>Array</code>
Gets the datasets the site can show

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Array</code> - objects with key, label, name and current (true for the dataset being shown)  
<a name="api.getDataSource"></a>

### api.getDataSource() ⇒ <code>string</code>
Gets the key of the dataset being shown

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
<a name="api.switchDataSource"></a>

### api.switchDataSource(key) ⇒ <code>boolean</code>
Switches to another dataset. The other methods return false until it
has loaded (sfdatasourceready).

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>boolean</code> - whether it switched (false if it is the current dataset, or isn't one)  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| key | <code>string</code> | dataset key |

<a name="api.getPlaces"></a>

### api.getPlaces() ⇒ <code>Array</code> \| <code>false</code>
Gets the places in the current dataset

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Array</code> \| <code>false</code> - objects with id, slug, title, lat, lng, shown (whether it matches the filters) and selected  
<a name="api.getSelectedPlace"></a>

### api.getSelectedPlace() ⇒ <code>Object</code> \| <code>null</code>
Gets the selected place

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Object</code> \| <code>null</code> - id, slug and title, or null if no place is selected  
<a name="api.selectPlace"></a>

### api.selectPlace(place) ⇒ <code>boolean</code>
Selects a place in the current dataset, which shows its details in the
list and its popup on the map

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>boolean</code> - whether there is a place with that slug or ID  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| place | <code>string</code> \| <code>number</code> | the place's slug or ID |

<a name="api.deselectPlace"></a>

### api.deselectPlace()
Deselects the selected place

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
<a name="api.getFilters"></a>

### api.getFilters() ⇒ <code>Array</code> \| <code>false</code>
Gets the current dataset's filters

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Array</code> \| <code>false</code> - objects with key, label, exclusive, additive and options (each with key and label)  
<a name="api.getFilterState"></a>

### api.getFilterState() ⇒ <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code>
Gets the checked filters and the search terms, and how many places match

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code> - the same as the detail of sffilterchange: dataSource, filters, search, shown and total  
<a name="api.setFilters"></a>

### api.setFilters(filters) ⇒ <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code>
Sets which filters are checked (the search is left as it is)

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code> - the new filter state (see getFilterState)  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| filters | <code>Object</code> | filter key: array of option keys, e.g. { facilities: [ 'wifi' ] }. Options not given are unchecked. |

<a name="api.setSearch"></a>

### api.setSearch(text) ⇒ <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code>
Searches the current dataset (the filters are left as they are)

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code> - the new filter state (see getFilterState)  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text | <code>string</code> | the search (letters, numbers and spaces; other characters are removed) |

<a name="api.clearFilters"></a>

### api.clearFilters() ⇒ <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code>
Unchecks all the filters and clears the search

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
**Returns**: <code>Object</code> \| <code>false</code> - the new filter state (see getFilterState)

<a name="api.toggleFullscreen"></a>

### api.toggleFullscreen()
Switches the map to full screen, or back. Browsers only allow this in
response to something the user did, such as a click, in the same
window, so it can't be done with postMessage from a page that embeds
the app in an iframe (the iframe needs allow="fullscreen" for the
app's own full screen button).

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
<a name="api.getRoute"></a>

### api.getRoute() ⇒ <code>string</code>
Gets the current route, e.g. cafes/courtyard-coffee (see routing.mjs)

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  
<a name="api.goTo"></a>

### api.goTo(route)
Goes to a route: a dataset, a place (dataset/slug) or a page (page/name)

**Kind**: static method of [<code>api</code>](#api)  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| route | <code>string</code> | e.g. trees/copper-beech, or page/about |
